title: Recipe scaler: adjust servings and ingredient amounts
description: Scale a recipe up or down: paste the ingredient list, enter how many servings it makes and how many you need — every amount is recalculated.

ui.invalid: Enter a number of servings greater than zero
ui.example:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup butter, softened
3/4 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
2 cups chocolate chips
